items.title: Clinical Reasoning: An Immunocompetent Young Adult With Acute Vision Loss.
items.abstract: A 23-year-old male patient presented to the emergency department with several days of exacerbating headaches, bilateral retrobulbar pain, and blurred vision. Ophthalmologic evaluation was consistent with bilateral optic neuritis (ON). MRI, CSF analysis, and blood tests were normal except for elevated liver enzymes and elevated cytomegalovirus-immunoglobulin G titers. Prompt treatment with intravenous methylprednisolone for acute ON was initiated, despite the concern for an acute systemic viral infection, resulting in rapid improvement in vision. This case report highlights the key differentiating findings and management between demyelinating, infectious, and para-infectious ON.
items.summary_ja:
背景：23歳の免疫正常な若年男性が、数日間悪化する頭痛、両眼後部痛、視力低下を訴え救急受診した。  
方法：眼科検査により両側視神経炎と診断され、MRI、脳脊髄液検査、血液検査を実施。肝酵素上昇とサイトメガロウイルス（CMV）IgG抗体価の上昇を認めたが、他の検査は正常であった。  
結果：急性視神経炎に対し、全身性ウイルス感染の懸念がある中であったが、メチルプレドニゾロンの静脈内投与を迅速に開始。これにより視力は速やかに改善した。  
結論：本症例は、脱髄性、感染性、準感染性視神経炎の鑑別診断と治療方針の重要なポイントを示しており、免疫正常者における急性視神経炎の臨床的対応の参考となる。
items.summary_short_ja: 23歳男性が数日間の頭痛、両眼後部痛、視力低下で来院。検査により両側視神経炎と診断され、MRIや髄液検査は正常だが肝酵素とサイトメガロウイルスIgGが上昇。急性視神経炎に対しメチルプレドニゾロン静注を開始し視力は迅速に改善した。本症例は脱髄性、感染性、準感染性視神経炎の鑑別と治療の重要性を示している。

items.title: Developing Interim Outcome Measures for Multi-Arm Multistage Clinical Trials in Multiple Sclerosis.
items.abstract: Multi-arm multistage (MAMS) clinical trials use interim outcome stage analyses to test multiple candidate treatments, determining which should proceed to the next trial stage. The reduced time, cost, and participant numbers, compared with current separated phases 2 and 3 clinical trials, could expedite the development of treatments in neurodegenerative diseases, such as progressive multiple sclerosis (PMS). MAMS trial interim outcomes must reflect the final stage outcome and be able to detect treatment effects with high power at interim stages. Patient-reported outcomes (PROMs) are cost-effective and highly accessible, making them promising MAMS trial interim outcome measures. We determined whether the MS Quality of Life 54 Physical Health Composite, MS Impact Scale 29 version 2 physical health subscore (MSIS-29v2 PH), MS Walking Scale 12 version 2 (MSWS-12v2), or their composite could act as interim outcome measures in MAMS PMS trials. Using a pooled analysis of 11,052 longitudinal visits from 3 PMS trials, we assessed the relationship of PROM change at early time points with 6-month confirmed disability progression (CDP) in the Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS) up to 36 months through Cox proportional hazards. To minimize PROM ceiling effects, we generated an MSIS-29v2 PH and MSWS-12v2 composite, prioritizing greatest change. We calculated the required sample size when these PROMs were used as interim measures. We analyzed 1,927 of the 2,046 available participants (mean age 54 [SD 7.2] years and 66% female). EDSS 6-month CDP risk was significantly associated with each 1-standard deviation 12-month score increase for the MSIS-29v2 PH (hazard ratio [HR] 1.20 [1.08-1.33]), MSWS-12v2 (HR 1.26 [1.13-1.40]), and composite (HR 1.29 [1.16-1.44]; all  Changes in the MSIS-29v2 PH, MSWS-12v2, and composite scores associated with ≥6-month EDSS CDP up to 36 months. The composite has sufficient statistical power to detect treatment effects at 12 months. These PROMs are well placed to play a role in interim analysis in MAMS trials in PMS.
items.summary_ja: 背景：多腕多段階（MAMS）臨床試験は、複数の治療候補を同時に評価し、次段階に進む治療を選定する手法であり、進行性多発性硬化症（PMS）などの神経変性疾患の治療開発を迅速化できる可能性がある。中間評価指標は最終評価と整合し、高い検出力を持つ必要がある。方法：患者報告アウトカム（PROMs）としてMS Quality of Life 54 Physical Health Composite、MS Impact Scale 29 version 2（MSIS-29v2 PH）、MS Walking Scale 12 version 2（MSWS-12v2）およびその複合指標を用い、3つのPMS試験から得た11,052回の縦断データを解析。PROMの早期変化と最大36ヶ月までの6ヶ月確定障害進行（CDP）との関連をCox比例ハザードモデルで評価した。結果：1,927名の解析対象者で、12ヶ月時点のPROMスコア1標準偏差増加はMSIS-29v2 PH（HR 1.20）、MSWS-12v2（HR 1.26）、複合指標（HR 1.29）と有意に関連。複合指標は12ヶ月時点で治療効果検出に十分な統計的検出力を持つことが示された。結論：MSIS-29v2 PH、MSWS-12v2およびその複合指標は、PMSのMAMS試験における中間評価指標として有望であり、治療開発の効率化に寄与する可能性が高い。
items.summary_short_ja: 多発性硬化症の進行型（PMS）における多腕多段階（MAMS）臨床試験で、中間評価指標として患者報告アウトカム（PROMs）の有用性を検討した。MSIS-29v2 PH、MSWS-12v2、およびその複合スコアは、12か月時点での変化が6か月確定障害進行（EDSS）と有意に関連し、複合スコアは治療効果検出に十分な統計的検出力を持つことが示された。これらPROMsはMAMS試験の中間評価に適している。

items.title: Sustained Benefits of a Multidomain Lifestyle Intervention in Multiple Sclerosis in the LIMS Study: A 24-Month Follow-Up.
items.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) often leads to physical, cognitive, and psychological impairments substantially affecting daily functioning and quality of life. Because current disease-modifying therapies do not fully prevent disease progression, interest has grown in the potential role of modifiable lifestyle factors. We evaluated (1) whether effects on patient-reported outcomes were sustained up to 24 months and (2) long-term changes in lifestyle behaviors after completion of the lifestyle in MS program. People with MS participated in a 3-month multimodal lifestyle program (i.e., Mediterranean-style diet, physical activity, and sleep and stress), followed by a 21-month maintenance phase. Patient-reported outcomes were assessed 3 months before the intervention, at baseline, postintervention, and after 6, 12, 18, and 24 months. The primary outcome was MS-related impact on daily functioning (MS Impact Scale-29 [MSIS-29]). Secondary outcomes included quality of life, general health, and MS-related symptoms. Longitudinal changes were analyzed using piecewise mixed-effects models, and individual-level change was evaluated using proportions exceeding the smallest detectable change (SDC). In total, 659 participants were included (mean age 46 years, SD 11; 84% female). During the intervention phase, MSIS-29 physical and psychological scores significantly decreased by approximately 0.8 and 1.1 points per month, respectively, followed by attenuation during long-term follow-up. This was reflected by within-group changes of -2.7 (-3.7; -1.8) and -3.7 (-4.8; -1.6) points after the intervention and -0.8 (-1.7; 0.3) and -3.4 (-4.6; -2.3) point at month 24, remaining significantly improved or stable relative to baseline. Only a small proportion of participants exceeded the SDC for MSIS-29 (approximately 4%-7%). Trajectories were broadly similar across other patient-reported outcomes, with modest short-term improvements and subsequent stabilization. Most pronounced effects were found for dietary adherence and body mass index, which improved substantially during the intervention and remained partially sustained during follow-up. No significant changes were observed in physical activity adherence. In this large, real-world study, a digital multimodal lifestyle intervention was associated with modest, mainly short-term improvements in patient-reported outcomes and more pronounced individual-level changes in dietary behavior and body composition. These findings support a complementary role for lifestyle interventions in long-term MS management. The study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT05402501; classic.clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT05402501).
items.summary_ja:
背景：多発性硬化症（MS）は身体的・認知的・心理的障害を引き起こし、生活の質に大きな影響を与える。既存の治療では進行を完全に防げないため、生活習慣の修正が注目されている。  
方法：MS患者659名（平均年齢46歳、女性84％）が、地中海式食事、運動、睡眠・ストレス管理を組み合わせた3か月間の多領域生活習慣プログラムに参加し、その後21か月間の維持期を経た。患者報告アウトカムは介入前3か月、介入開始時、終了時および6、12、18、24か月後に評価。主な評価指標はMSの影響を測るMSIS-29。  
結果：介入期間中、MSIS-29の身体的・心理的スコアは月あたり約0.8点および1.1点有意に改善し、その後は緩やかに安定。介入終了時点での改善は持続し、24か月後も基準値より良好な状態を維持。食事遵守率とBMIは大幅に改善し、フォローアップ期間中も部分的に維持されたが、運動習慣の変化は見られなかった。  
結論：デジタル多領域生活習慣介入はMS患者の自己報告アウトカムに主に短期的な改善をもたらし、特に食事行動と体組成に顕著な変化を促した。生活習慣介入はMSの長期管理における補完的役割を果たす可能性が示された。
items.summary_short_ja: 多発性硬化症（MS）患者を対象に、地中海式食事、運動、睡眠・ストレス管理を組み合わせた3か月間の生活習慣介入と21か月の維持期を実施。患者報告アウトカムでは、身体的・心理的影響が介入中に有意に改善し、その後も24か月まで安定または改善を維持。特に食事遵守と体重指数の改善が顕著で、運動習慣は変化なし。生活習慣介入はMSの長期管理に補完的効果が期待される。
